title: MutationOperatorSchema
description: Schema v3 for mutation operator records. Extends the original proposal schema with the fields the generation engine consumes (name, scheme, mode, placeholders, attacker_values, template) and structures injection_location. Operators may be authored as JSON or YAML. v3 adds the optional 'effect' block (observable, check, requires) used by the attack-effect oracle in src/engine/validator.py. DRAFT: to be agreed with Debora.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the operator.

description.description: Plain-English explanation of the abstract attack pattern.

target_build_phase.description: Which build phase the operator applies to.

scheme.description: Placement strategy that locates where this operator can be injected.

mode.description: How the single-field change is applied by the engine.

injection_location.description: Where in a target project the change occurs.

file_glob.description: Glob (relative to project root) matching candidate files, e.g. 'subprojects/*.wrap'.

field.description: Name of the field/line the operator targets, e.g. 'source_url'.

placeholders.description: Map of {{PLACEHOLDER}} name -> description for values resolved from the target project by the placement step.

attacker_values.description: Map of {{PLACEHOLDER}} name -> concrete value supplied by the operator (the attacker), which the target project cannot provide.

template.description: The change to apply. May contain {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens resolved from placeholders and attacker_values.

file_path.description: Target file, usually '{{WRAP_FILE}}' or another resolved path.

preconditions.description: Requirements that must hold for the operator to produce a valid mutant.

source_attacks.description: Names of real attacks (from the taxonomy) this operator generalizes.

effect.description: What the attack does when it works, and how the harness confirms it. A mutant counts as 'effective' only if this effect is observed with no defense running.

observable.description: Effect type. Each is checked against the clean baseline in one harness output: file_write -> markers.txt, network_fetch/env_exfil -> mock_server.log, artifact_diff/test_input_swap -> hashes.txt.

check.description: Optional narrowing of the default check for the observable.

marker.description: Substring the PWNED_* marker path must contain (file_write).

request_path.description: Substring the mock-server request line must contain (network_fetch, env_exfil).

contains.description: Substring the request line must contain; env_exfil defaults to the harness canary secret.

artifact.description: Build output path as written in hashes.txt (e.g. 'build/git') whose hash must differ.

tests_may_fail.description: Meson test names the attack is expected to break; failures here do not block build_valid.

requires.description: Operator ids that must be applied first (e.g. wrap_source_url_swap requires wrap_hash_removal).
